title: Understanding MSE
text: Mean Squared Error (MSE) is a common measure of the quality of an estimator. It is calculated as the average of the squares of the errors—that is, the average squared difference between the estimated values and the actual value.

title: Checking for Unique Solutions
text: To determine if there is a unique solution for the parameters, consider the design matrix formed by the features. If this matrix is full rank, then a unique solution exists. What does it mean for a matrix to be full rank?

title: Linear Independence
text: If the columns of the design matrix are linearly independent, it means no column can be written as a linear combination of the others. This is crucial for ensuring a unique solution.
